title: Stop the price call from hanging forever

task.text: When the price service hangs, every checkout request hangs with it.
Fix `Gateway.fetch(Remote, long timeoutMs)` so that a call which does not finish in time is **bounded and cancelled**.

items: After `timeoutMs` the caller gets a `TimeoutException`, never an endless wait.
The abandoned work is cancelled with an interrupt, so it stops using its pool thread.
If the caller is interrupted while waiting, the work is cancelled too and `InterruptedException` propagates.
A remote that throws still surfaces as `ExecutionException` with the original cause.
Signatures and the `Remote` interface stay as they are.

checks.title: A fast call returns its value
A hanging call ends in TimeoutException
An interrupted caller cancels the work
fetch never waits without a bound

hints.text: `Future.get()` waits as long as the work does. A timeout has two halves: stop *waiting*, and stop the *work*.
Use the `Future.get(long, TimeUnit)` overload. When it throws, call `cancel(true)` on the `Future` so the worker thread is interrupted, then let the exception continue.
